description: Inside Secure FIPS Cryptographic Module is a FIPS 140-2 Security Level 1 validated software cryptographic module from Inside Secure. The module is a toolkit which provides the most commonly needed cryptographic primitives for a large variety of applictions, including, but not limited to, primitives for DAR, DRM, TLS, and VPN on mobile devices.
